statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2021-0153 is an informational notice that the encoding crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes it transitively through lindera-dictionary, whose only located encoding API references are in a documentation-only asset path rather than Milvus production execution. Removing the dependency cleanly still requires an upstream Lindera dependency migration and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2021-0153.html
